registered_rule.asymmetry: NEGATIVE is a legitimate one-model result; POSITIVE is not a result

ANNOTATION_2026_07_30_verdict_not_readab.why: the registered asymmetry makes a NEGATIVE the cheap outcome, which is exactly the condition under which an underpowered instrument fabricates one. This run has NO positive control. A measured null is inadmissible until one passes. Same failure as R36, one layer down.

defects_found_after_the_run.outcome_should_be_SIGNED: E[|Delta r|] > 0 under the no-mechanism null and its value is set by the NOISE MAGNITUDE, which itself covaries with c_h. So |Delta r| has a null centre that MOVES WITH THE PREDICTOR and can be nonzero with zero mechanism. Signed Delta r has null mean exactly 0 under exchangeability. Registered direction: rho(Delta r, -c_h) > 0.
defects_found_after_the_run.rectification_bias: sum_t|e_hat_t| is a POSITIVELY BIASED estimator of sum_t|e_t|, maximal where |e_t|/sigma -> 0. A high-cancellation head is BY DEFINITION one with many near-zero e_t, so low-c_h heads carry the MOST inflated m_h — and .final effects are 2-10x smaller than .all, so the two conditions carry DIFFERENT bias whose difference is monotone in c_h. That is a nonzero X from noise alone, in the registered direction.
defects_found_after_the_run.shared_noise_coupling: c_h and m_h are estimated from the SAME 64 instances, so their errors are correlated by construction. Needs a 32/32 cross-fit: c_h from half A, both rank vectors from half B, averaged over >=50 splits.
defects_found_after_the_run.T_too_low: registered T = max(0.15, RES); the correct form is max(0.15, 2*RES). Spearman z variance is 1.06/(n-3), not 1/(n-3), and the 10 layers are NOT independent strata — they share the same 64 base instances — so any parametric pooled SE is wrong in an unknown direction. The bootstrap is the ONLY admissible CI source.
defects_found_after_the_run.instrument_control_units_error: I compared R19 effect spreads against R11 mean_sem_band raw. They are not commensurable: R11 base_margin 4.4768 vs R19 baseline_margin_mean 1.6357 (2.74x), 120 items vs 64 base instances, and R11 heads are band-selected. Both must be normalised by their own baseline margin first. This is the MW/W units family.
defects_found_after_the_run.reliability_unmeasured: within-layer split-half reliability of m_h was never computed. If it is far below 0.7, Delta r is mostly noise, X is attenuated toward 0, and the negative is manufactured.

ANNOTATION_2026_07_30_verdict_not_readab.what_survives: the null was verified NON-degenerate before reading (sd 0.1038 partialled, 0.0989 raw) — unlike R36 the floor could move. And the mechanical path was measured BEFORE building, not after: corr(c_h, m_h(.all)) = +0.3839 within layer.
